content.comment_body: Hello everyone, Is it possible to connect a [product_name] with a CodeSys soft PLC using Ethernet?

[product_name] [article_no] of the first generation only supports Ethernet TCP/IP with [company_name] protocol. The second and third generations of [product_name] [article_no] additionally support Modbus TCP/IP along with [company_name] protocol over Ethernet TCP/IP.
No problem, task cycle can be set to 200ms or possibly even shorter.
